source: ASPEN Paediatric and Neonatal Nutrition Support Handbook, Third Edition, 2024: Growth Monitoring, term infants and paediatric patients, 'Reference normal growth velocity'
provenance: Transcribed by hand from a screenshot Edison supplied on 2026-11-08. Checked against the handbook by Edison (dietitian) on 2026-11-08: all values match, including 21-21 for girls 3 to 6 months (I59 closed). One range is derived, not published (girls 3 to 6 months, D164).
bands_in_months: Each band runs from from_months up to, not including, to_months. Months are 30.4375 days.

bands.girls_note: The handbook gives 21-21 for girls (a single value, confirmed by Edison). A range is needed to compare against, so it is centred on 21 with a half-width of 4.0 g/day, the average of the half-widths of the girls rows either side (2-3 months: 3.5, 6-9 months: 4.5). Derived, not published (D164, I66).

bands.note: Source row '2 - <4 years', not split by sex.
Source row '4 - 7 years', not split by sex. Only the part under 5 years is used here.

not_transcribed: Rows for 7 years and older: the engine screens children under 5.
Length and height velocity: beyond 12 months the source gives one value, not a range, and length measurement error is large compared with the daily rates. Not used (D160).

Preterm infant monitoring (15-20 g/kg/d, length over 1 cm/week, head circumference 0.8-1 cm/week, initial weight loss up to 15% regained in 10-14 days): needs per-kg rates and head circumference. Not used (D161).
